subject: Great House Farm, Llandough (now Church View Close)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Stephen Doughty MP,

I am writing to follow up on my previous email regarding Great House Farm,
Llandough, and the concerns I raised about historical records, council
involvement, and transparency surrounding this matter.

I have not received a substantive reply and would appreciate an update on
whether you are able to assist or raise the matter with the relevant
authorities.

As this concerns a historic site of local importance and questions about
past decisions affecting the community, I believe it warrants proper
consideration.

Please could you confirm whether this has been reviewed and advise what
further action can be taken.

I look forward to your response.

Kind regards,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)

[address redacted], Dinas Powys, [postcode redacted]
